purpose: Ensure receipts can support traceability instead of being only conversational replies.
consistency_rules: If a receipt mentions real action fields, it must include real_system_triggered false or a redline blocker.
current_state must come from the shadow state enum and must not be a formal publishing state.
If missing_inputs is empty, the receipt must explain why the shadow task can close.
next_action cannot be a real action such as direct publish or direct render.
Alignment handoff records must list changed files.
failure_handling: On failure, generate a field gap list only; do not modify public WeCom config, real interfaces, or formal repositories.
